name: vox
description: Local-first Apple voice stack with embeddable Swift packages, Vox Companion, a Bun CLI, and TypeScript clients.

scripts.build: bun run --cwd packages/client build && bun run --cwd packages/cli build && bun run --cwd packages/web-client build && swift build --package-path swift
scripts.build:all: bun run build && bun run site:build
scripts.app:build: sh -c 'swift_build_path="app/.build-$(swift --version | shasum | cut -d " " -f 1)"; swift build --package-path app --scratch-path "$swift_build_path"'
scripts.app:launch: sh -c 'swift_build_path="app/.build-$(swift --version | shasum | cut -d " " -f 1)"; VOX_SHOW_SETTINGS_ON_LAUNCH=1 swift run --package-path app --scratch-path "$swift_build_path" Vox --show-settings'
scripts.site:build: bun run --cwd site build && bun run docs:build && cp -r docs-site/dist/. site/out/
scripts.test: bun test packages/client/test packages/cli/test packages/web-client/test && swift test --package-path swift
scripts.test:e2e: swift build --package-path swift --product voxd --product voxbridge && VOX_E2E=1 bun test packages/client/test/transcribe-file.e2e.test.ts packages/web-client/test/live-session.e2e.test.ts
